en.t: The 13-year-old Lothair III is crowned at the Abbey of Saint-Remi as king of the West Frankish Kingdom
en.s: The Musée Saint-Remi is an archeology and art museum in Reims, France. The museum is housed in the former Abbey of Saint-Remi, founded in the sixth century and which had been keeping since 1099 the relics of Saint Remigius (the Bishop of Reims who converted Frankish king Clovis I to Christianity in 496). The Basilica of Saint-Remi, adjacent to it and consecrated in 1049, was its abbey church.

zh.t: 13岁的洛泰尔三世在圣雷米修道院加冕为西法兰克王国国王
zh.s: 圣雷米博物馆是法国兰斯的一座考古与艺术博物馆，设于旧圣雷米修道院内。修道院始建于6世纪，自1099年起保存圣雷米的遗物；圣雷米是兰斯主教，曾于496年使法兰克国王克洛维一世皈依基督教。毗邻修道院、于1049年祝圣的圣雷米圣殿曾是其修道院教堂。

en.s: The Battle of Holmengrå (Norwegian: Slaget ved Holmengrå) was a naval battle fought on 12 November 1139 near the island Holmengrå south of Hvaler, between the forces of the child kings Sigurd Haraldsson and Inge Haraldsson on the one side, and on the other side the pretender Sigurd Slembe and his ally King Magnus the Blind (by Sigurd's claim his nephew).

zh.s: 霍尔门格罗战役（挪威语：Slaget ved Holmengrå）是一场海战，于1139年11月12日在瓦勒尔以南的霍尔门格罗岛附近进行。交战双方一边是幼王西居尔·哈拉尔松和英格·哈拉尔松的部队，另一边是王位觊觎者西居尔·斯莱姆贝及其盟友、失明者马格努斯国王（按西居尔的说法是他的侄子）。

en.s: The siege of Tyre took place from 12 November 1187 to 1 January 1188. An Ayyubid army commanded by Saladin made an amphibious assault on the city, defended by Conrad of Montferrat. After two months of continuous struggle, Saladin dismissed his army and retreated to Acre.

zh.s: 提尔围城战于1187年11月12日至1188年1月1日进行。萨拉丁率领阿尤布王朝军队从海上进攻提尔，蒙费拉托的康拉德守城。持续两个月的战斗后，萨拉丁解散军队，撤退到阿卡。

en.s: The Battle of Posada (9–12 November 1330) was fought between Basarab I of Wallachia and Charles I of Hungary (also known as Charles Robert). The small Wallachian army led by Basarab, formed of cavalry and foot archers, as well as local peasants, managed to ambush and defeat the 30,000-strong Hungarian army, in a mountainous region. The battle resulted in a major Wallachian victory.

zh.s: 波萨达战役（1330年11月9日至12日）是瓦拉几亚的巴萨拉布一世与匈牙利国王查理一世（又称查理·罗贝尔）之间的战斗。巴萨拉布率领的瓦拉几亚小部队由骑兵、步弓手和当地农民组成，在山区设伏，击败了3万人的匈牙利军队。这场战斗以瓦拉几亚大胜告终。

en.s: In 1539, Andrea Doria succeeded in recapturing the cities of Kelibia, Sousse, Monastir, and Sfax on behalf of the Hafsid prince. However, Kairouan remained in open revolt, and the Hafsid ruler sought to avenge his earlier defeat at the hands of the Chabbia tribes.

en.s: The Battle of Brentford was a small pitched battle which took place on 12 November 1642 in Brentford, Middlesex, between a detachment of the Royalist army (predominantly horse with one regiment of Welsh foot) under the command of Prince Rupert, and two infantry regiments of Parliamentarians with some horse in support. The result was a victory for the Royalists.

zh.s: 布伦特福德战役是一次小规模的阵地战，于1642年11月12日在米德尔塞克斯郡布伦特福德发生。交战一方是鲁珀特亲王指挥的保王党军队一支分遣队，主要由骑兵和一个威尔士步兵团组成；另一方是议会派的两个步兵团及部分骑兵。保王党获胜。

en.s: The Siege of Bonn took place from 3 to 12 November 1673, during the Franco-Dutch War. Bonn, located in present-day Germany, was the residence of the Elector of Cologne and held by a garrison composed of troops from France and the Electorate of Cologne. The city was strategically significant due to its location on the Rhine and the capture of the city disrupted French lines of communication and logistics so much that they were forced to evacuate their troops in the Dutch Republic.

zh.s: 波恩围城战发生于1673年11月3日至12日，属于法荷战争的一部分。波恩位于今德国境内，是科隆选侯的驻地，由法国和科隆选侯国军队组成的守军控制。该城位于莱茵河畔，具有重要战略地位。攻占波恩严重扰乱了法军的交通和补给线，迫使法军撤出荷兰联省共和国境内。

en.s: The siege of Inverness that took place in November 1715 was part of the Jacobite rising of 1715. The town of Inverness and Inverness Castle were being held by the Clan Mackenzie, led by Sir John Mackenzie of Coul who supported the rebel Jacobite cause. Simon Fraser, 11th Lord Lovat, chief of the Clan Fraser of Lovat besieged them, supported by men of the Clan Rose and Clan Forbes.

zh.s: 1715年11月12日，苏格兰因弗内斯遭围攻，这场战斗是当年詹姆斯党起义的一部分。支持詹姆斯党的约翰·麦肯齐爵士率族人守卫城镇和城堡；洛瓦特勋爵西蒙·弗雷泽则在罗斯氏族和福布斯氏族支援下围攻他们。

en.s: The siege of Perekop (Russian: Штурм Перекопа; storming of Perekop) on June 1 (OS: 21 May), 1736, was part of the Russo-Turkish War (1735–1739). Russian field marshal Burkhard Christoph von Münnich (known in Russia as Minikh) successfully stormed the Turkish fortifications at the Isthmus of Perekop and left the Tatar fortress Fortress Or Qapi (known as Perekop Fortress in Russian) in ruins.

zh.s: 佩列科普围城战（俄语：Штурм Перекопа，即“攻占佩列科普”）于1736年6月1日（旧历5月21日）发生，是1735—1739年俄土战争的一部分。俄国陆军元帅布尔哈德·克里斯托夫·冯·明尼希（俄国称米尼赫）成功攻破佩列科普地峡上的土耳其防御工事，并将鞑靼人的奥尔卡普城堡（俄语称佩列科普堡）夷为废墟。

en.s: On November 12, 1757 during the French and Indian War, a company of French and Indian warriors staged an attack on German Flatts, on the north side of the Mohawk River in the British Province of New York. The settlement of Palatine German refugees and their families was destroyed, and many of the men, women and children were taken prisoner.

zh.s: 1757年11月12日，法印战争期间，一支法国和印第安战士组成的队伍袭击了英国纽约省莫霍克河以北的德意志弗拉特斯。定居点里的普法尔茨德意志难民及其家人遭到屠杀，许多男女和儿童被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Sialkot took place on 12 November 1763, between the Durrani Empire, led by Jahan Khan, and the Sukerchakia Misl, led by Charat Singh, as part of the Afghan–Sikh wars which concluded with Sikh victory.

zh.s: 锡亚尔科特战役于1763年11月12日爆发，交战双方是贾汉·汗率领的杜兰尼帝国与查拉特·辛格率领的苏克查基亚米斯尔。战斗属于阿富汗—锡克战争的一部分，最终以锡克人获胜告终。

en.s: In the Battle of Caldiero on 12 November 1796, a Habsburg Austrian army led by Jozsef Alvinczi fought a First French Republic army commanded by Napoleon Bonaparte. The French assaulted the Austrian positions, which were initially held by the army advance guard under Prince Friedrich Franz Xaver of Hohenzollern-Hechingen. The defenders held firm until reinforcements arrived in the afternoon to push back the French. This marked a rare tactical setback for Bonaparte, whose forces withdrew into Verona that evening after having suffered greater losses than their adversaries. The action occurred during the War of the First Coalition, which was part of the French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 1796年11月12日，约瑟夫·阿尔温齐率领哈布斯堡奥地利军队，与拿破仑·波拿巴指挥的法兰西第一共和国军队交战。法军进攻奥军阵地，起初由弗里德里希·弗朗茨·克萨韦尔·霍亨索伦-黑欣根亲王率领的前卫部队坚守。奥军增援于下午抵达并击退法军。这是波拿巴少见的一次战术挫折：法军损失较大，当晚撤入维罗纳。战斗发生在第一次反法同盟战争期间，该战争属于法国大革命战争的一部分。

en.s: The Canoe Fight was a skirmish between Mississippi Territory militiamen led by Captain Samuel Dale and Red Stick warriors that took place on November 12, 1813 as part of the Creek War. The skirmish was fought largely from canoes and was a victory for the militiamen, who only had one member wounded. The victory held little military value in the overall Creek War but its participants gained widespread notoriety for their actions during the fight.

zh.t: 独木舟战斗（克里克战争）
zh.s: 独木舟战斗是克里克战争期间的一场小规模交战，于1813年11月12日发生。塞缪尔·戴尔上尉率领的密西西比领地民兵与红棍派战士交战。战斗主要在独木舟上进行，民兵获胜，仅有一人受伤。这场胜利对整个克里克战争影响不大，但参战者因战斗表现而广为人知。

en.t: 1816 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: A presidential election was held in Delaware on November 12, 1816, as part of the 1816 United States presidential election. The unpledged Federalist electoral candidates were selected by the Delaware General Assembly over the Democratic-Republican candidates, who were pledged to James Monroe. en.t: Construction is completed on the Wilberforce Monument in Kingston Upon Hull
en.s: The Wilberforce Monument is a monument honouring English politician and abolitionist William Wilberforce in Kingston Upon Hull, England. The ashlar structure consists of a Doric column topped by a statue of Wilberforce. Construction on the monument began in 1834 and was completed the following year. In 2011, it was designated a Grade II listed structure.

zh.t: 赫尔河畔金斯顿的威尔伯福斯纪念碑竣工
zh.s: 威尔伯福斯纪念碑位于英格兰赫尔河畔金斯顿，纪念英国政治家、废奴主义者威廉·威尔伯福斯。这座由规整石块砌成的纪念碑采用多立克柱式，柱顶立有威尔伯福斯雕像。工程于1834年开始，次年完工，2011年被列为英国二级登录建筑。

Powell defeated a Confederate cavalry brigade commanded by Brigadier General John McCausland. The fight took place in Nineveh, Virginia, near the road from Newtown to Front Royal, which is known as the Front Royal Pike.

zh.s: 尼尼微战斗是美国内战期间于1864年11月12日发生的一场骑兵战斗。威廉·H·鲍威尔准将率领的联邦军骑兵师击败了约翰·麦考斯兰准将指挥的邦联军骑兵旅。战斗发生在弗吉尼亚州尼尼微，靠近纽敦通往弗兰特罗亚尔的道路，即弗兰特罗亚尔公路。

en.t: Capture of the steamer Marquês de Olinda
en.s: The Capture of the steamer Marquês de Olinda, also called the Battle of Potrero-Poña, was a Paraguayan naval action carried out on 12 November 1864, in Potrero-Poña, on the Paraguay River, which consisted of the capture of the Brazilian merchant ship and all on board. Paraguayan president Solano López ordered the imprisonment in response to the Brazilian invasion of Uruguay, before any formal declaration of war between Paraguay and the Empire of Brazil.

zh.t: “马尔克斯·德·奥林达”号轮船被俘
zh.s: “马尔克斯·德·奥林达”号轮船被俘事件（也称波特雷罗—波尼亚战役）是巴拉圭于1864年11月12日在巴拉圭河波特雷罗—波尼亚实施的一次海军行动，巴军俘获了巴西商船及船上所有人员。巴拉圭总统索拉诺·洛佩斯下令扣押该船，以回应巴西入侵乌拉圭；当时巴拉圭与巴西帝国尚未正式宣战。

en.t: The frozen bodies of Robert Scott and his men are found on the Ross Ice Shelf in Antarctica
en.s: The Ross Ice Shelf is the largest ice shelf of Antarctica (as of 2013, an area of roughly 500,809 km2 (193,363 mi2) and about 800 km (500 mi) across: about the size of France). It is several hundred metres thick. The nearly vertical ice front to the open sea is more than 600 km (370 mi) long, and between 15 and 50 m (50 and 160 ft) high above the water surface.

zh.s: 罗斯冰架是南极洲最大的冰架。截至2013年，其面积约为500,809平方公里（193,363平方英里），宽约800公里（500英里），相当于法国的面积。冰架厚达数百米，面向外海、近乎垂直的冰缘长逾600公里（370英里），高出水面约15至50米（50至160英尺）。

en.t: Eight months after perishing during the ill-fated Terra Nova Expedition, the bodies of Robert Falcon Scott (pictured) and his companions were discovered on the Ross Ice Shelf in Antarctica
en.s: Captain Robert Falcon Scott (6 June 1868 – c. 29 March 1912) was a British naval officer and explorer who led two expeditions to the Antarctic regions: the Discovery Expedition of 1901–1904 and the Terra Nova Expedition of 1910–1913. On the first expedition, Scott set a new southern record by marching to latitude 82°S and discovered the Antarctic Plateau, on which the South Pole is located.

zh.s: 罗伯特·法尔肯·斯科特上校（1868年6月6日—约1912年3月29日）是英国海军军官和探险家，曾率领两支南极探险队：1901—1904年的“发现号”探险队和1910—1913年的“特拉诺瓦”探险队。第一次探险期间，斯科特率队徒步抵达南纬82度，创下新的南行纪录，并发现南极高原，南极点就位于该高原上。

en.t: Dissolution of Austria-Hungary: Austria becomes a republic. After the proclamation, a coup attempt by the communist Red Guard is defeated by the social-democratic Volkswehr
en.s: The dissolution of Austria-Hungary was a major political event that occurred as a result of the growth of internal social contradictions and the separation of different parts of Austria-Hungary. The more immediate reasons for the collapse of the state were World War I, the worsening food crisis since late 1917, general starvation in Cisleithania during the winter of 1917–1918, the demands of Austria-Hungary's military alliance with the German Empire and its de facto subservience to the German High Command, and its conclusion of the Bread Peace of 9 February 1918 with Ukraine, resulting in uncontrollable civil unrest and nationalist secessionism.

zh.s: 奥匈帝国解体是一场重大政治事件，源于内部社会矛盾加剧以及帝国各地分离。更直接的原因包括第一次世界大战、1917年末开始恶化的粮食危机、1917—1918年冬天奥地利部分地区普遍饥饿、与德意志帝国军事同盟所带来的压力及奥匈帝国事实上受德国最高统帅部支配，以及1918年2月9日与乌克兰签订《面包和约》后出现的失控民众动乱和民族主义分离运动。

en.s: The Treaty of Rapallo was an agreement between the Kingdom of Italy and the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes in the aftermath of the First World War. It was intended to settle the Adriatic question, which referred to Italian claims over territories promised to the country in return for its entry into the war against Austria-Hungary, claims that were made on the basis of the 1915 Treaty of London. The wartime pact promised Italy large areas of the eastern Adriatic. The treaty, signed on 12 November 1920 in Rapallo, Italy, generally redeemed the promises of territorial gains in the former Austrian Littoral by awarding Italy territories generally corresponding to the peninsula of Istria and the former Princely County of Gorizia and Gradisca, with the addition of the Snežnik Plateau, in addition to what was promised by the London treaty.

zh.s: 《拉帕洛条约》是第一次世界大战后意大利王国与塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国签署的协议，旨在解决亚得里亚海问题。意大利依据1915年《伦敦条约》提出领土要求，作为参战对抗奥匈帝国的回报。战时协定承诺将亚得里亚海东部大片地区交给意大利。条约于1920年11月12日在意大利拉帕洛签署，大体兑现了意大利取得奥地利沿海地区领土的承诺，将伊斯特拉半岛、原戈里齐亚和格拉迪斯卡亲王领大致对应的地区以及斯涅日尼克高原划归意大利，并落实《伦敦条约》中的其他承诺。

en.s: A referendum on withdrawing from the League of Nations was held in Germany on 12 November 1933 alongside Reichstag elections. The measure was approved by 95.1% of voters with a turnout of 96.3%. It was the first of a series of referendums held by the German cabinet under Chancellor Adolf Hitler, after the cabinet conferred upon itself the ability to hold referendums on 14 July 1933. The referendum question was on a separate ballot from the one used for the elections.

All opposition parties had been banned by the Law Against the Formation of Parties (14 July 1933), and voters were presented with a single list containing Nazis and 22 non-party "guests" (Gäste) of the Nazi Party.

en.t: On 12 November 1933, Sabit Damolla declared the establishment of the East Turkestan Republic with Khoja Niyaz as its president — despite the fact that the respected commander was engaged in fighting in northern Xinjiang and had allied his forces with those of Sheng Shicai
en.s: The Turkic Islamic Republic of East Turkestan (TIRET) was a breakaway state centered on the city of Kashgar, located in the far west of China's Xinjiang Province. It is often described as the First East Turkestan Republic to differentiate it from the Second East Turkestan Republic (1944–1946) established exactly a decade later. It emerged from the Kumul Rebellion following the abolition of the semi-autonomous Kumul Khanate by Xinjiang Governor Jin Shuren.

zh.t: 东突厥斯坦共和国成立
zh.s: 1933年11月12日，萨比特·达莫拉宣布成立东突厥斯坦共和国，并推举和加尼牙孜为总统；尽管这位受尊敬的指挥官当时正在新疆北部作战，且已与盛世才结盟。东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国是一个以喀什为中心的分离政权，位于中国新疆最西部。它常被称为第一东突厥斯坦共和国，以区别于十年后成立的第二东突厥斯坦共和国（1944—1946）。该政权源于哈密起义；此前新疆省长金树仁废除了半自治的哈密汗国。

en.s: The prefectural assembly elections (Japanese: 州會議員選舉) were held on 12 November 1936 in Taiwan under Japanese rule. According to the Japanese law, half members of prefectural assembly shall be elected by the members of local assembly and the other half be appointed by the Governor-General (總督). In this time, 76 seats from five prefectural assemblies were open for election. Voting was done by Electoral colleges form by the 3,600 members of local assemblies. Half of them (1,800) were directly elected in the previous year, the other half were appointed by the prefectural governor (州知事).

en.s: The Naval Battle of Guadalcanal, sometimes referred to as the Third and Fourth Battles of Savo Island, the Battle of the Solomons, the Battle of Friday the 13th, or, in Japanese sources, the Third Battle of the Solomon Sea (第三次ソロモン海戦 Dai-san-ji Soromon Kaisen), took place from 12–15 November 1942, and was the decisive engagement in a series of naval battles between Allied (primarily American) and Imperial Japanese forces during the months-long Guadalcanal Campaign in the Solomon Islands during World War II. The action consisted of combined air and sea engagements over four days, most near Guadalcanal and all related to a Japanese effort to reinforce land forces on the island.

zh.s: 瓜达尔卡纳尔海战有时也称萨沃岛第三、第四次海战、所罗门群岛海战、“13号星期五”海战，或按日文称第三次所罗门海战。战斗于1942年11月12日至15日进行，是第二次世界大战期间，瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役数月海战中的决定性一役。盟军（主要是美国）与日本帝国军队在所罗门群岛交战。战斗持续4天，由空战和海战组成，大多发生在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛附近，均与日军向岛上增派陆军有关。

en.s: The Battle of the Treasury Islands was a Second World War battle that took place between 27 October and 12 November 1943 on the Treasury Islands group; part of the Solomon Islands as part of the Pacific Theatre. The Allied invasion of the Japanese held island group intended to secure Mono and Stirling Islands so that a radar station could be constructed on the former and the latter be used as a staging area for an assault on Bougainville. The attack on the Treasury Islands would serve the long term allied strategy of isolating Bougainville and Rabaul and the elimination of the 24,000 strong garrison in the area.

en.s: Operation Catechism was the British air raid of World War II that destroyed the German battleship Tirpitz. The ship capsized after being hit by at least two bombs and damaged by the explosions of others, killing between 940 and 1,204 members of the crew; the British suffered no casualties.

Three other parties contested the election: the BVI United Party (UP) led by Conrad Maduro (which fielded six candidates), the newly formed Progressive People's Democratic Party (PPDP) led by former Chief Minister Willard Wheatley (which fielded five candidates), and the newly formed Independent People's Movement (IPM) which fielded only two candidates.

zh.s: 英属维尔京群岛于1990年11月12日举行大选。首席部长拉维蒂·斯托特领导的执政维尔京群岛党大获全胜。其他3个政党也参选：康拉德·马杜罗领导的英属维尔京群岛联合党派出6名候选人，前首席部长威拉德·惠特利领导的新成立进步人民民主党派出5名候选人，新成立的独立人民运动则派出2名候选人。

en.s: The 1991 Guelph municipal election was held on November 12, 1991, in Guelph, Ontario, Canada, to elect the Mayor of Guelph, Guelph City Council and the Guelph members of the Upper Grand District School Board (Public) and Wellington Catholic District School Board. The election was one of many races across the province of Ontario. It was also the first since 1930 to use wards to elect members of city council rather a citywide vote.

en.s: The city of Ottawa, Canada held municipal elections on November 12, 1991. Right wing Britannia Ward councillor Jacquelin Holzman defeated left wing St. George's councillor Nancy Smith and mayor Marc Laviolette. Holzman defeated Smith by just 3,022 votes. She ran on a platform to "keep a lid on city taxes".

Nuštar was situated near Vukovar and Vinkovci, it was a major necessity to the Croatian defenders at Vukovar and Vinkovci, due to its road that led to nearby villages and towns, which had supplied the Croats in Vukovar.

The election was noted as a defeat for incumbents. Three sitting mayors were defeated: June Rowlands in Toronto, Fergy Brown, in York, and Bruce Sinclair of Etobicoke.

en.s: STS-74 was the fourth mission of the US/Russian Shuttle–Mir program, and the second docking of the Space Shuttle with Mir. Space Shuttle Atlantis lifted off from Kennedy Space Center launch pad 39A on 12 November 1995. The mission ended 8 days later with the landing of Atlantis back at Kennedy. It was the second in a series of seven straight missions to the station flown by Atlantis.

zh.s: STS-74是美俄航天飞机—和平号计划的第四次任务，也是航天飞机第二次与和平号空间站对接。亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机于1995年11月12日从肯尼迪航天中心39A发射台升空。任务8天后结束，亚特兰蒂斯号返回肯尼迪航天中心着陆。这是该航天飞机连续执行的7次空间站任务中的第二次。

en.s: The Erdut Agreement (Serbo-Croatian: Erdutski sporazum / Ердутски споразум), officially the Basic Agreement on the Region of Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium, is an agreement reached on 12 November 1995 between the authorities of the Republic of Croatia and the local Serb authorities of the Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia region on the peaceful resolution to the Croatian War of Independence in eastern Croatia.

en.s: The 1999 Düzce earthquake occurred on 12 November at 18:57:22 local time with a moment magnitude of 7.2 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent), causing damage and at least 845 fatalities in Düzce, Turkey. The epicenter was approximately 100 km (62 mi) to the east of the extremely destructive 1999 İzmit earthquake that happened nearly three months earlier.

Later, the other contestant withdrew his nomination making Chowdhury elected to the post of President. Badruddoza sworn in on 14 November 2001, and assumed the office of President.

en.s: American Airlines Flight 587 was a regularly scheduled international passenger flight from John F. Kennedy International Airport, New York City, to Las Américas International Airport, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. On November 12, 2001, the Airbus A300 flying the route crashed into the neighborhood of Belle Harbor on the Rockaway Peninsula of Queens, New York City, shortly after takeoff, killing all 251 passengers and nine crew members aboard, as well as five people on the ground.

zh.s: 美国航空587号班机是从纽约约翰·肯尼迪国际机场飞往多米尼加共和国圣多明各美洲国际机场的定期国际航班。2001年11月12日，执飞该航线的空客A300起飞后不久坠毁在纽约市皇后区洛克威半岛贝尔港社区。机上251名乘客和9名机组人员全部遇难，地面另有5人死亡。

en.s: Super Tuesday was a 1-hour professional wrestling television special event, produced by the World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) that took place on 12 November 2002 (which was taped November 4 & 5) at the Fleet Center in Boston, Massachusetts and Verizon Wireless Arena in Manchester, New Hampshire, which featured matches from both Raw and SmackDown. en.s: Operation Phillis was the British service-assisted evacuation operation for British citizens in Côte d'Ivoire in November 2004. en.s: The 2009 Glasgow North East by-election was a by-election for the Parliament of the United Kingdom's House of Commons constituency of Glasgow North East. The by-election was held on 12 November 2009 following the resignation of Michael Martin as an MP and as Speaker of the House of Commons following the MPs' expenses scandal. Martin was the first Speaker since Sir John Trevor in 1695 to be forced from office. Willie Bain, the Scottish Labour Party candidate, won with 59% of the vote. en.s: On 12 November 2015, two suicide bombers detonated explosives in Bourj el-Barajneh, a southern suburb of Beirut, Lebanon, that is inhabited mostly by Shia Muslims. Reports of the number of deaths range from 37 to 43. Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) claimed responsibility for the attacks. The bombings were the worst terrorist attack in Beirut since the end of the Lebanese Civil War. They came twelve days after the bombing of a Russian airliner over the Sinai Peninsula killed 224 people and a day before attacks in Paris killed 136. ISIL claimed responsibility for these attacks as well.

en.s: The 2023 FAI Cup final, known as the 2023 Sports Direct FAI Cup final for sponsorship reasons, was the final match of the 2023 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of the Republic of Ireland. zh.s: 2023年FAI杯决赛也称2023年Sports Direct FAI杯决赛（因赞助而得名），是爱尔兰共和国全国足球杯赛的最后一场比赛。比赛于2023年11月12日星期日在都柏林的阿维瓦体育场举行，对阵双方是波希米亚人队和圣帕特里克竞技队。

en.s: Ultimate Party 2023 was a professional wrestling event produced by CyberFight's DDT Pro-Wrestling (DDT). The event took place on November 12, 2023, in Tokyo at the Ryōgoku Kokugikan. It was the third event under the Ultimate Party chronology. The event aired live on AbemaTV and on DDT's streaming service Wrestle Universe. Twelve matches were contested at the event, including two on the pre-show.

zh.s: 《Ultimate Party 2023》是CyberFight旗下DDT职业摔角主办的赛事，于2023年11月12日在东京两国国技馆举行。这是《Ultimate Party》系列第三场赛事。赛事通过AbemaTV和DDT的Wrestle Universe流媒体服务直播，共有12场比赛，其中2场在预热节目中进行。

en.s: Doc NYC (stylized as DOC NYC) is an annual documentary film festival in New York City. Co-founded by Thom Powers and Raphaela Neihausen, the festival is the country's largest documentary film festival with over 300 films and events and 250 special guests. By 2014, DOC NYC had become America's largest documentary film festival and voted by MovieMaker magazine as one of the "top five coolest documentary film festivals in the world".
